maintainers.name: Adphi
maintainers.role: Sole active maintainer of linka-cloud/d2vm: authored 90 of the last 100 non-merge commits, reviews and merges external PRs, and cuts releases.

proposal.architecture_precedent: Single shared ubuntu-latest host with QEMU for all CI jobs; no native-per-architecture runner rows and no wheel matrix. arm64 precedent is goreleaser goarch plus grub-efi-arm64 (PR 44).
proposal.existing_riscv64_work: None upstream (no issue, PR, CI or docs). The luhenry fork's riscv64-draft branch was deliberately not read per the issue instruction.
proposal.fork_guards: None: ci.yaml has no github.repository conditions; secret-bearing steps are gated by tag or main ref instead.

path_coverage.assessment: Go build via Makefile and .goreleaser.yaml (goarch amd64/arm64) with a Dockerfile; no Python wheel build exists, and enabling riscv64 would require Go code and release matrix changes outside wheel scope.
ci.yaml runs go vet/tests and distro e2e on ubuntu-latest through QEMU; no wheel test job exists to extend.
Release is goreleaser binaries plus Docker image, gated on tags with project secrets; no PyPI or wheel publication.
No pyproject.toml, setup.py or wheel metadata; distribution is Go binaries, a Docker image and a Homebrew tap.
README and docs/content never mention architectures beyond arm64 and contain no wheel docs.
The Go code (builder.go, pkg/qemu/qemu.go, cmd/d2vm/run/qemu.go, grub*.go) hardcodes amd64/arm64 and x86 syslinux/grub paths; it is not a native wheel source.

proposal.rationale: d2vm is a Go VM-image builder with no Python package, wheel, PyPI release, or build backend, and no riscv64 discussion upstream. A riscv64 wheel contribution cannot exist; any riscv64 support would be Go and bootloader feature work outside this pipeline's wheel scope. A human can resume with a class and paths if Go riscv64 support is desired.
proposal.release_coverage: Latest release v0.4.0 ships Go binaries for linux/windows/darwin on amd64 and arm64 and a Docker image; no wheels; riscv64 absent.
proposal.risks: Not a wheel project; a riscv64 build requires Go, QEMU, grub and extlinux work that upstream has not requested and whose maintainer requires e2e coverage.
